seo.titleZh: 联系 | Xiangyin Gu – 艺术家与研究者 — Xiangyin Gu
seo.description: Get in touch with Xiangyin Gu, a London-based artist and PhD researcher specializing in psychoanalysis, memory studies, and archival art practices. Whether you are interested in exhibitions, collaborations, teaching, or research inquiries, you can reach out via email or phone for personalized assistance and support.
seo.descriptionZh: 联系 Xiangyin Gu——一位常驻伦敦的艺术家与博士研究者，专注于精神分析、记忆研究与档案艺术实践。无论你对展览、合作、教学还是研究咨询感兴趣，都可以通过电子邮件或电话取得联系。
